# s2

```clojure
(def Fixture-methods
  {run
   {:does "do the one deed"
    :in #{:input}
    :out :thing
    :how "the mechanism"}})
```

```clojure
(def Fixture-data
  {:input {:type string :as input :lives :external :holds "what comes in"}
   :thing {:as thing :lives run :holds "what comes out, with no type"}})
```
